frase_inicial: Michael: your plan must cover the January home buy, keep enough cash, and still get you to a secure retirement

tarjetas.frente: January 2027 home purchase is the pivot
tarjetas.reverso: If you use the savings set aside now for the down payment, the investment base that funds retirement gets smaller and monthly cash tightens. That trade-off is the central choice you face.
tarjetas.detalle: Down payment hold of $113,300 required January 2027 for $566,500 purchase

tarjetas.frente: Cash cushion is thinner than your plan assumes
tarjetas.reverso: You have only a few months of expenses in accessible cash, so a bill, pay cut, or the home timing could force selling investments or relying on the credit card.
tarjetas.detalle: Accessible cash $30,000 equals about 3.2 months of essential expenses before near-term goals

tarjetas.frente: Retirement gap comes from drawing on the same paycheck
tarjetas.reverso: You save a lot each year but your income is already committed. Boosting retirement savings or closing the retirement shortfall competes directly with the home and the cash cushion.
tarjetas.detalle: Plan estimates a retirement gap requiring about $20,231 more per year to close

tarjetas.frente: Insurance holes could wipe savings in a claim
tarjetas.reverso: Your life cover and liability protection are far below recommended levels. A big claim or sudden loss of income would hit your liquid savings and derail the home or retirement plan.
tarjetas.detalle: Life cover $180,000; recommended minimum $900,000. No umbrella; recommended $1,000,000

tarjetas.frente: High-rate credit card is an easy win, but it trades with cash needs
tarjetas.reverso: Paying the card faster saves interest for you, yet the same cash could be used to shore up the emergency reserve or the home down payment. It's a straight trade you must choose.
tarjetas.detalle: Credit card balance $3,500 at 20% APR, $200 monthly payment projected payoff July 2028

movimientos.title: Add umbrella cover
movimientos.action: Add $1M of umbrella to raise the liability shield

movimientos.title: Lower the withdrawal rate
movimientos.action: Cutting withdrawals to $10,300/year (6.0%) reaches the sustainable band

movimientos.title: Raise growth allocation toward glide
movimientos.action: Move the invested mix from 74% to 88% growth (glide 98%) for the next horizon-fit band — about $19,900 of the invested book

mapa.aviso: Illustrative simulator: it shows the direction of change, not a Sherpas projection.

siguiente_paso.razon: An umbrella policy raises the liability shield that otherwise exposes your liquid savings and net worth; it directly protects the home purchase and retirement base.
pasos: Call your auto insurer or agent and ask if they sell umbrella liability cover
Get one quote for the minimum recommended amount and note the premium and start date
Decide whether the premium fits your budget or if you prefer to delay purchase until after the down payment
